label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

This looks like a CRLF line-ending issue, not a malformed file. parseStatement() splits the input only on "\n" (lines.split("\n")), so when a file uses Windows-style "\r\n" line endings (likely from the new accounting export tool), each line keeps a trailing "\r". For the header line this means the last column name ends up as e.g. "description\r" instead of "description", so REQUIRED_COLUMNS.some(...) fails to find "description" in the header and assertShape() throws errors.rowShape for row 1 (the header check runs with index 0, reported as row 1) every time, regardless of the actual column layout.

Fix should strip trailing "\r" from each line (or split on /\r?\n/) before processing the header and rows in src/ingest/parser.ts.
